title: Frontend refactor to match Paper designs
summary: Refactor app/{js,styles,index.html,assets}/ to match the four artboards in the Paper file 'SaBlava Kayaks' (page 'prototip-1'). Backend (app/server.py) is frozen. Work is split into four sequential sessions, each owned by one agent in one session.

backend.note: Do not modify. Static server only — no API, no build step.

stack.rule: Keep vanilla JS modules + plain CSS. No bundler, no framework. Hash router stays.

constraints.browser_target: iOS Safari + Chrome Android, viewport ~390–402px wide

design_source.ignore: Any frame or artboard on the page named 'trash' is scratch work — do NOT pull fonts, palette, components, or layout cues from it. Only 'prototip-1' is canonical.

artboards.note: Splash. Logo + 'KAYAKS & PADDLE SURF' wordmark + horizon line with kayak silhouette.

Language picker. Square (364x364) beach watercolor hero, 'Benvingut!' headline, 'Tria el teu idioma' label, 4 rows (circular flag SVG + language name + right-side check on selected), 'Veure rutes' primary CTA.
Weather hero (watercolor scene + mascot sun dialog) → 'Rutes' list with painted map cards. No Mapbox on this screen.

Back + map widget (labeled 'interactive-rive-map' — static SVG in Phase 1.2, Rive deferred to Phase 2) + horizontal POI carousel + 'Recorda' reminders + fixed 'Comença ruta' CTA + 'Duració' bottom sheet. 'Comença ruta' opens the Phase-2 guided tour (out of scope here).

Mapbox map fills the screen (the teal/turquoise background = the live map). POI card overlays the bottom: back button (top-left, over the map), numbered title (01 POI name) with next-arrow, hero photo, body text. Card sits over the map — not a separate full-bleed screen.

before_starting_a_session: Confirm the previous session's `committed: true` and a matching commit_sha. If false, hand back to user.
Read the Paper design with mcp__paper__get_screenshot + get_tree_summary for the artboard(s) in scope.
Read the existing code files listed in the session's `files_in_scope`.
Update this file: set `status: 'in_progress'`, write start time in `started_at`.
during_the_session: Tick `tasks[].done` to true as each task completes.
Take Paper screenshots at meaningful milestones to verify visual fidelity (Review Checkpoints).
If you discover work outside the session's scope, add it to `discoveries[]` rather than expanding scope.
before_committing: Run every check in `verification[]`. Set its `passed` to true with a one-line note.
Manually open http://localhost:5173/ and walk the screen(s) in scope on a 402px-wide viewport. Update `manual_qa.notes`.
Set `tested: true` only when all verification checks + manual QA pass.
Only then commit. Set `committed: true` and write the commit SHA into `commit_sha`.
